name: What are the main phases of the kitchen remodeling process?

mainEntity.name: What are the main phases of the kitchen remodeling process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with design and budgeting, followed by material ordering, demolition, rough-in trades, drywall, and finish installation. After design plans are finalized and materials are ordered, crews demolish the existing space. Next, licensed trades rough in new plumbing, electrical, and ventilation before inspections occur. Once rough-in work passes inspection, teams hang drywall, install flooring, set cabinetry, and template for countertops. The final stretch covers countertop installation, backsplash tile, plumbing and lighting trim, appliance hookups, and a final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process moves through design planning, demolition, rough mechanical work, inspections, drywall, cabinet installation, countertop fabrication, trim work, and final fixtures.
